 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d53b93c0.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The horizontal solid-color row separates two panels. Compare how much
    # each non-background marker color increases in the lower panel.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, grid[divider][0])}
    upper = grid[:divider]
    lower = grid[divider + 1:]
    increase = {c: sum(v == c for row in lower for v in row) - sum(v == c for row in upper for v in row) for c in colors}
    chosen = max(sorted(colors), key=lambda c: increase[c])
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
"
}
